notes.title: VOICE ACTING UPDATE - FEBRUARY 16th PATCH
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_pkdbEKvf1o;full][/previewyoutube]



[u][b]Add a new layer of immersion to your story in Ankh-Seah![/b][/u]

Effective February 16th - Episode 1 of The Nameless Braves: Heaven will have all dialogue fully voice acted by the wonderful talents at VPG Studio!

This update will be free for all users, and will also come with slightly fine tuned writing throughout the episode. 



[b]A Word on Episode 2[/b]

I know it has been far too long since i made a written devlog regarding Episode 2 update progress. Well, this is partially why!

Preparing for this update did require me to take time away from Episode 2, and also adds a bit more to the overall workload for Episode 2 - however, I think it will absolutely be worth the wait!

I promise I will deliver more updates for Episode 2 when the time comes. I am hoping to deliver a release date in due time, and am so excited for Episode 3 after it!


As always, do keep an eye out for more updates! Hoping to make them far more frequent in 2024!


[b]-ArsSanctum[/b]

notes.title: The Nameless Braves Heaven: Episode 2 - Update#3
notes.content:
​We meet again!

This update is a day late due to holiday things and such, but I thankfully have made quite a bit of progress. Save for music, sound effects, editing/writing passovers and additional artwork, Episode 2 Chapter 2 is finished! (I know that sounds like a lot that still needs doing, but that's only about 20% of the work that has already been done)

E2C3 is also well underway. It is a far lengthier chapter than E2C2 was, and I am missing some assets I'll need to fully complete it, but I can get it about 70% complete before moving on to E2C4. As of right now the script is ported into engine and I've got a fair bit of character art set up within it.

I have the rest of today and most of tomorrow to get more work done. I'm hoping to finish as much of E2C3 as I can and get started on E2C4 before I leave. The back half of my vacation will be spent away from home and away from my PC, and I'll be far too occupied to do much on mobile either. Still, the progress made is already terrific and I don't need too much mandatory artwork.

As I suspected in my last update, I will indeed need some more expressions for major characters - so I'll try to see that tended to ASAP.

In the interim, you can all meet another new character! This is Marco, a young orphan boy. He's a bit timid but he means well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42558206/f760ccf65e5f9c4aa312ef007bfc7240d90d247d.png[/img]


Next week's update may also be late, as I don't expect to get back home until Sunday night and I have to work early in the AM on Monday!

Nevertheless, I will see you all next week!

notes.title: Episode 2 - Update #2
notes.content:
Hello again.

Pretty basic/light ​update this week.

E2C2's script has been ported over and formatted to Ren'py. Images for about 30% of it are inserted as well, and an equal amount of transitions/flair is in.

Progress is mildly hindered by the need to get some bgs and char art, the latter is mostly underway but I need to reach out to thinhnguyen who did most of my commissioned bgs last year regarding the new additions.

I also feel as though Elijah and a few other mainstays are a touch too limited on the expression front.

It's a bit of a hassle to get new expressions for existing chars as it requires me to re-crop their renders for the engine (reference hunting is also a mindnumbing process)- BUT I want the most immersive experience for you guys as possible, and my characters ARE expressive (mostly) so that should translate to the VN!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42558206/9fcf89f5702b5b4dd35690cd4a31e09288f0dac7.png[/img]

Other than that, I'll introduce a new character that you'll be meeting this Episode. Her name is Aurora! A short young lady with hair and skin as white as snow. She looks a bit tired, doesn't she? Or maybe there's something else going on...

Next two updates should be more substantitve. I go on vacation after this Friday, so work won't stall out my progress as usual.

Stay tuned!
